Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Writ Petition No. 20329 of 2024
O R D E R:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development appearing for respondent No.1, Sri G.Malla Reddy, learned Standing Counsel appearing for respondent No.2, and with the consent of the counsel appearing for the respective parties, the Writ Petition is taken up for hearing and disposal at admission stage.

2. Having regard to the manner of disposal and the lis involved in this Writ Petition, this Court is of the view that notice to unofficial respondents No.3 & 4 is not necessary for adjudication of the present Writ Petition.

3. In this present Writ Petition, the petitioner has assailed the action of the respondents-authorities in seeking to lay a road/widen the road through the petitioner's property to an extent of 581.45 sq.
yards in survey No.4 situated at Manchirevula Village, Gandipet Mandal, Ranga Reddy District,
without initiating any proceedings to acquire the land and pay compensation in terms of the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as being illegal and arbitrary.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. When the matter is taken up for hearing on 'admission' on 31.07.2024 and thereafter on 02.08.2024, learned Standing counsel appearing on behalf of the 2nd respondent submitted that the authorities are not taking any steps to lay a road through the petitioner's land and in the event the authorities intend to further action, they would follow due process of law.

5. Today when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that after the aforesaid statement made to this Court by the learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the 2nd respondent on 02.08.2024, the respondents-authorities have stopped laying of road and thus, the grievance of the petitioner stands redressed.
6. I have taken note of the respective submissions made.

7.
